overloads.semanticRole: Returns a pointer to the arrType array (style/color/background-color/row-control) associated with the list box or list box column, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag). Array-type list boxes only.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a pointer to the arrType array (style/color/background-color/row-control) associated with the list box or list box column, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*'). Array-type list boxes only.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
